_comment: How WebPivot presents itself when fetching, and how it recognises a page that refused to serve. Both are DATA because both go stale on a schedule nobody controls: a browser ships a new major version every few weeks, and Cloudflare rewords its interstitial. RULE 1: generic constants only.

ua_pool._comment: THE ONE DEFAULT User-Agent source for the whole toolkit, loaded by wp_ua.py: the first entry is DEFAULT_UA, sent on every request (targets, archives and vendor/index APIs alike); the full list is rotated across requests so a multi-page crawl does not hit a target from one identical fingerprint. KEEP THESE FRESH — a UA advertising a browser two years stale is itself a bot tell, and that is the whole reason this list is tunable without a redeploy. ANDROID CHROME ONLY (project decision): never desktop/iOS — use real, current Android Chrome strings. Two standalone-fallback copies must match the first entry: BinaryPivot/references/binary_indicators.json -> android_user_agent and Engage/references/engage.json -> fetch.user_agent.

ua_exceptions._comment: The ONLY places allowed to send something other than the Android default, each because the SERVICE requires it. Documentation, not configuration: the string itself lives with the owner named here. Adding a User-Agent literal anywhere else is a policy violation.

values.reason: archive.org rate-limits a browser User-Agent sent by a script client

a self-hosted instance may allowlist its API clients
explicit analyst opt-in to fetch the payload a desktop victim receives; the default stays Android

cloudflare_body_markers._comment: Lowercased substrings that identify a Cloudflare managed-challenge / interstitial body rather than the site's real content. Getting this wrong is expensive in both directions: miss a marker and the challenge page is collected AS the site (its favicon and DOM hash then cluster every challenged domain together); add something too generic and real pages are discarded as challenges. Cloudflare rewords these and localises them, so extend as you meet new ones.
values: enable javascript and cookies to continue
